description: Gate guard in 8th Fighter Interceptor Squadron 'Night Fighters' livery. Recorded on base since at least 1987.
Displayed carrying the name 'Budjak'. Duncan's F-86 register queries whether this and 51-13468 have been confused with one another.
Displayed in Blue Diamonds aerobatic team livery; first noted 20 March 1993.
Mounted on a pole along the flight line in Air Superiority Silver livery.
Gate guard, wearing FA-499; photographed on base during the 88th AFP anniversary flag-raising, 21 December 2023.
Ex-Philippine Air Force Crusader preserved on base.
Photo-reconnaissance Shooting Star displayed on base, wearing 457.
Displayed outdoors at 5th Fighter Wing headquarters in Project Falcon Uniform livery.
Displayed outdoors at the 430th Aircraft Maintenance Group maintenance complex in Red Aces livery; visible in a January 2023 US DoD photograph of the complex.
